text:
Type: bottle-shaped art glass vase
Use: holding a single stem or dried branches, standing alone as a sculptural piece; living room, dining room, shelf or sideboard
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: hand-blown glass with swirls of colored glass inside
Colors: black and dark brown swirls, clear glass
Shape: tall slim bottle with a narrow neck and a slightly crooked, organic body, irregular dark marbling, slender and lightweight
Feel: artistic, bold, dramatic, handmade
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, black accents, dried grasses; contemporary, modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: FIRANDE
product.description: The vase is handmade, which means that all the vases in the series have a unique look and none are exactly the same.
